attempts.source: fn(x R) N {x} = fn(y R) N {y}
attempts.evidence: anonymous function body x is not verified to belong to declared return set N
attempts.lesson: An exact return carrier requires verifier-owned body membership; the compiler must not synthesize a cast or axiom.

accepted_blocks.source:
forall f fn(x R, y {z R: z > x}) R:
    f = f
accepted_blocks.lesson: A later parameter set can consume the earlier parameter through its exact membership witness.

accepted_blocks.source:
forall f fn(x R) {z R: z > x}, a R:
    f(a) = f(a)
accepted_blocks.lesson: Application returns the argument-indexed subtype rather than erasing it to a universal carrier.

accepted_blocks.source: fn(x R) R {x + 1} = fn(y R) R {y + 1}
accepted_blocks.lesson: The verifier records an owned binder scope and exact body-membership closure for each anonymous value.

accepted_blocks.source:
forall a R:
    fn(x R) R {x + 1}(a) = fn(x R) R {x + 1}(a)
accepted_blocks.lesson: The application WD object identifies the exact anonymous FunctionHead and checked argument membership.
